module.title: Pharmacy Identity, Sites, Catalog and Pricing
module.business_purpose: A pharmacy is an independent data-owning organization even when physically located inside a hospital, office or nursing facility. It can operate through direct backend integration or manual data entry without sharing unrestricted access to the host organization's data.
